tree.text: What do you do with money?
tree.statement: 本节问题引导学生思考可以用一元钱买什么。
tree.explanation: Get Ready 部分通过引导问题激发对货币用途的思考。

children.text: What can you buy with one yuan?
children.notes: What can you buy with... 意为“用...你能买什么”。
children.statement: 这个句子询问一元钱可以购买什么物品。
children.explanation: one yuan 意为一元钱。

tree.notes: 关于零花钱如何使用的话题
tree.statement: 本节主要讨论如何合理管理和规划零花钱。
tree.explanation: Start Up 部分围绕 Sam 和 Amy 的不同理财行为展开。

children.text: Sam and Amy get pocket money every week.
children.cn: 萨姆和埃米每周都得到零花钱。
children.notes: pocket money 意为“零花钱”。
children.statement: Sam 和 Amy 每月得到一次零花钱。
children.explanation: every week 意为“每周”，而不是“每月”。

children.text: Amy always saves her money.
children.notes: saves 是动词 save 的三单形式，表示储蓄。
children.statement: Amy 的习惯是把零花钱存起来。
children.explanation: saves her money 意为存钱。

children.text: Sam always spends his.
children.notes: spends 是 spend 的三单形式；his 是名词性物主代词，指代 his money。
children.statement: Sam 总是把钱存下来。
children.explanation: spends 意为花费，Sam 总是把钱花掉。

children.text: Buying a robot
children.notes: Sam 购买机器人的对话
children.statement: Sam 询问机器人的价格并买下了它。
children.explanation: Sam 花了 35 元买下机器人。

children.speaker: Sam
children.text: How much is the robot?
children.notes: How much is... 用来询问单数物品的价格。
children.statement: 这句是在问机器人的价格。
children.explanation: How much 用来询问价格，robot 是单数用 is。

children.speaker: Shopkeeper 1
children.text: It's 35 yuan.
children.notes: It's 是 It is 的缩写，代指 robot。
children.statement: 这个机器人的价格是35元。
children.explanation: It's 35 yuan 表示价格是35元。

children.speaker: Sam
children.text: I'll take it.
children.notes: I'll take it 是买东西时的常用口语，表示决定购买。
children.statement: I'll take it 意思是“我不想要它”。
children.explanation: I'll take it 表示“我买下了/我要了”。

children.text: Buying ice creams
children.notes: Sam 购买冰淇淋的对话
children.statement: Sam 买了两个冰淇淋，共花费 8 元。
children.explanation: 两个冰淇淋价格是 8 元。

children.speaker: Sam
children.text: I want two ice creams. How much are they?
children.cn: 我要两个冰淇淋。它们多少钱？
children.notes: two ice creams 表示两个冰淇淋，是复数，所以问价用 How much are they?
children.statement: 因为冰淇淋是复数，所以动词用 are。
children.explanation: 复数问价使用 How much are they?

children.speaker: Shopkeeper 2
children.text: They're eight yuan.
children.notes: They're 是 They are 的缩写，指代两个冰淇淋。
children.statement: 冰淇淋的价格总共是八元。
children.explanation: They're eight yuan 意为它们是八元。

children.speaker: Sam
children.text: Here you are.
children.notes: Here you are 是给别人东西或付款时的常用语。
children.statement: Here you are 意思是“请把东西给我”。
children.explanation: Here you are 意为“给你”。

children.text: School Reading Week
children.notes: 阅读周给儿童之家赠书
children.statement: Amy 给儿童之家送了许多书，而 Sam 没有足够的钱。
children.explanation: Amy 存了钱买新书，Sam 只有两个硬币。

children.text: The School Reading Week is coming.
children.notes: is coming 意为“即将到来”。
children.statement: 阅读周已经结束了。
children.explanation: is coming 表示“即将到来”，还未开始或结束。

children.text: Amy has many new books for the children's home.
children.cn: 埃米有很多新书给儿童之家。
children.notes: children's home 意为“儿童之家/孤儿院”。
children.statement: Amy 准备了许多新书送给儿童之家的孩子们。
children.explanation: Amy 用存下的钱买了许多新书给儿童之家。

children.text: But Sam has only two coins.
children.notes: only 意为“只有/仅仅”。
children.statement: Sam 此时有很多钱买礼物。
children.explanation: Sam 只有两个硬币（two coins），没有多余的钱了。

children.speaker: Amy
children.text: Hi, these books are for you!
children.notes: these books 意为“这些书”。
children.statement: Amy 把书送给了孩子们。
children.explanation: Amy 把新书带到了儿童之家。

children.speaker: All
children.text: Thanks, Amy!
children.notes: Thanks 表示感谢。
children.statement: 大家感谢 Amy 的赠书。
children.explanation: All Thanks Amy 意为大家都谢谢埃米。

children.speaker: Sam
children.text: I'll save my money for the right things from now on.
children.cn: 从现在开始，我会为了正确的事情存钱。
children.notes: from now on 意为“从今以后/从现在开始”。
children.statement: Sam 决定以后要把零花钱用在有意义、正确的事情上。
children.explanation: save money for the right things 指为正确的事存钱。

tree.notes: 迈达斯国王与点石成金的故事
tree.statement: 这个故事告诉我们金钱/黄金并不是生命中唯一重要的东西。
tree.explanation: The golden touch 通过寓言故事传递了理性的金钱观。

children.text: King Midas and his wish
children.cn: 迈达斯国王与他的愿望
children.notes: 故事开头介绍国王与老人的相遇
children.statement: Midas 国王非常爱黄金并许下了愿望。
children.explanation: Midas 遇到了能够帮他实现愿望的老人。

children.text: Long long ago, there was a king called Midas.
children.cn: 很久很久以前，有一个叫迈达斯的国王。
children.notes: called 意为“被称作/名叫”。
children.statement: 故事发生在很久很久以前。
children.explanation: Long long ago 意为很久很久以前。

children.text: He loved gold very much.
children.notes: loved 是一般过去时。
children.statement: 国王 Midas 对黄金一点兴趣也没有。
children.explanation: He loved gold very much 意为他非常喜欢黄金。

children.text: One day he met an old man.
children.notes: met 是 meet 的过去式。
children.statement: met 是一般过去时形式。
children.explanation: met 表示遇见（过去发生的事）。

children.text: The old man said, "Do you have a wish? I can make it come true."
children.cn: 老人说：“你有什么愿望吗？我能让它实现。”
children.notes: make sth. come true 意为“使某事实现/成真”。
children.statement: come true 的中文意思是“成真，实现”。
children.explanation: come true 意为实现。

children.text: "I wish for a golden touch," said Midas.
children.cn: “我想要拥有点石成金的法力，”迈达斯说。
children.notes: wish for 意为“希望得到/渴望”。
children.statement: Midas 渴望得到点石成金的能力。
children.explanation: wish for a golden touch 意为想要点石成金的法力。

children.text: "I want to turn everything to gold!"
children.cn: “我要把每样东西都变成金子！”
children.notes: turn ... to ... 意为“把...变成...”。
children.statement: Midas 想要把所有东西都变成金子。
children.explanation: turn everything to gold 意为把一切变成金子。

children.text: "Are you sure?"
children.notes: Are you sure? 询问对方是否确定。
children.statement: 老人问 Midas 是否确定要这个愿望。
children.explanation: Are you sure 意为确定吗。

children.text: "Yes. I am very sure."
children.notes: very sure 意为非常确定。
children.statement: Midas 非常确定自己的决定。
children.explanation: I am very sure 意为我很确定。

children.text: The wish comes true
children.notes: 愿望带来短暂快乐后造成了巨大痛苦
children.statement: 食物和女儿都变成了黄金。
children.explanation: 点石成金的法力让食物和女儿都变成了金子。

children.text: Midas turned everything around him to gold.
children.cn: 迈达斯把他周围的每样东西都变成了金子。
children.notes: around him 意为“在他周围”。
children.statement: 迈达斯周围的东西都变成了金子。
children.explanation: turned everything to gold 意为把每样东西变成金子。

children.text: He was happy.
children.notes: was happy 表示当时开心。
children.statement: 迈达斯刚开始很开心。
children.explanation: He was happy 意为他当时很高兴。

children.text: Then Midas was hungry.
children.notes: hungry 意为饥饿的。
children.statement: 迈达斯后来感到饿了。
children.explanation: was hungry 意为饿了。

children.text: But all his food also turned to gold.
children.cn: 但是他所有的食物也变成了金子。
children.notes: all his food 意为“他所有的食物”。
children.statement: 迈达斯的食物变成了金子导致他无法进食。
children.explanation: food turned to gold 意为食物变成了金子。

children.text: His daughter came in.
children.notes: came in 意为“走进来”。
children.statement: 女儿走进了房间。
children.explanation: came in 意为进来。

children.text: Midas took her hand.
children.notes: took her hand 意为“牵她的手”。
children.statement: 迈达斯碰了女儿的手。
children.explanation: took her hand 表示拉手。

children.text: She turned to gold, too!
children.notes: turned to gold 意为“变成金子”。
children.statement: 女儿也变成了黄金雕像。
children.explanation: she turned to gold 意为她也变成了金子。

children.text: Regret and lesson
children.notes: Midas 恳求撤销愿望并明白了黄金并非一切
children.statement: 故事最后老人撤销了法力，Midas 明白了道理。
children.explanation: Gold isn't everything 是故事的主旨。

children.text: Midas was very sad.
children.notes: very sad 意为非常伤心。
children.statement: 迈达斯感到非常悲伤。
children.explanation: was very sad 意为非常伤心。

children.text: He cried, "I don't want gold now. I want food. I want my daughter back."
children.cn: 他哭喊道：“我现在不要金子了。我要食物。我要我的女儿回来。”
children.notes: want ... back 意为“想要...回来”。
children.statement: 迈达斯哭着说他现在更想要食物和女儿。
children.explanation: 他哭喊着要食物和女儿，不要金子。

children.text: He asked the old man to get everything back again.
children.cn: 他请求老人把一切恢复原样。
children.notes: ask sb. to do sth. 意为“请求某人做某事”。
children.statement: Midas 请求老人把东西恢复原状。
children.explanation: get everything back again 表示恢复原样。

children.text: "How much is it? I have so much gold," asked Midas.
children.cn: “这需要多少钱？我有好多黄金，”迈达斯问。
children.notes: so much gold 意为“如此多的黄金”。
children.statement: Midas 问恢复原状需要多少钱。
children.explanation: How much is it 询问价格。

children.text: The old man smiled, "Just remember, gold isn't everything."
children.cn: 老人微笑着说：“记住，黄金不是一切。”
children.notes: isn't everything 意为“不是一切/并非万能”。
children.statement: 老人告诉迈达斯，黄金并不是世界上唯一重要的东西。
children.explanation: gold isn't everything 表达黄金并非万能，人情和生命更宝贵。

tree.statement: 这是一首关于合理存钱、花钱以及分享的歌谣。
tree.explanation: 歌谣探讨了存钱、消费和分享的行为。

children.text: With money in my saving box, I make clever choices.
children.cn: 存钱罐里有钱，我做出了明智的选择。
children.notes: saving box 指存钱罐；clever choices 指明智/聪明的选择。
children.statement: saving box 是垃圾箱的意思。
children.explanation: saving box 意为存钱罐。

children.text: Sometimes I buy ice creams or crayons.
children.cn: 有时我买冰淇淋或彩色蜡笔。
children.notes: Sometimes 意为“有时/偶尔”。
children.statement: 作者有时用零花钱买冰淇淋或彩色蜡笔。
children.explanation: buy ice creams or crayons 意为买冰淇淋或彩色蜡笔。

children.text: Sometimes I save for a special day.
children.cn: 有时我为特别的日子存钱。
children.notes: save for 意为“为...存钱/储备”。
children.statement: 作者所有的零花钱都会在当天全部花光。
children.explanation: Sometimes I save 意为有时他会把钱存起来。

children.text: But I share some, too. It's a good thing for us to do.
children.cn: 但我也分享一些。这是我们应该做的善事。
children.notes: share sth. 意为“分享某物”。
children.statement: 分享给他人也是使用零花钱的一件好事。
children.explanation: It's a good thing for us to do 意为这是我们应该做的好事/善事。

tree.cn: 图图给爸爸的生日礼物
tree.notes: 听力练习关于图图如何爱心使用零花钱
tree.statement: 本篇听力展示了图图把买礼物的钱捐给了有需要的人。
tree.explanation: 图图的爱心得到了爸爸的夸奖。

children.text: What did Tutu give his dad for his birthday?
children.cn: 图图为他爸爸的生日送了什么？
children.notes: for his birthday 意为“作为他的生日礼物”。
children.statement: 这个句子询问图图送给爸爸的生日礼物是什么。
children.explanation: give sth for birthday 意为送生日礼物。

children.text: Why was Tutu's mum surprised?
children.cn: 为什么图图的妈妈很吃惊？
children.notes: surprised 意为“感到吃惊的”。
children.statement: 图图妈妈吃惊是因为图图拿了50元钱买礼物。
children.explanation: Because Tutu took 50 yuan to buy a gift for Dad.

children.text: What did Tutu do with his money?
children.cn: 图图用他的钱做了什么？
children.notes: do with money 意为“处理/使用钱”。
children.statement: 图图在商店里看到了捐款箱并把钱都放进去了。
children.explanation: He put all his money into the donation box for people in need.

children.speaker: Tutu's dad
children.text: Your loving heart is the best birthday gift for me.
children.cn: 你充满爱的心对我来说是最好的生日礼物。
children.notes: loving heart 意为“充满爱的心”；best birthday gift 意为“最好的生日礼物”。
children.statement: 爸爸认为图图的爱心是最好的生日礼物。
children.explanation: loving heart is the best birthday gift 表示爱心是最好的礼物。
